title: Sigma ORB Runner Strategy
summary: A simpler 15 minute Opening Range Breakout model for ES/NQ futures. It trades the first close outside the ORB, uses breakout candle midpoint entry, adaptive ORB-range stop distance, 2R target, day-of-week and contract-month filters, and emits webhook payloads that should be routed through Sigma approval-only middleware.
requiredConditions: Current contract month is not banned
First close outside ORB high or ORB low occurs
Entry is calculated from breakout candle midpoint
Adaptive stop distance is calculated from current and historical ORB ranges
Target is calculated from configured reward:risk
Sigma approval gate accepts the plan before any execution path

validation.status: Backtests are still under review; user reports some variants are negative.
knownConcerns: Allowed-day and skipped-month filters may be overfit
Midpoint entry may not be fill-realistic from TradingView alerts
Adaptive range rule must be tested across more regimes
Ghost/Tradovate route must be replaced with Sigma approval-only route before production
